tagbox.$description: TagBox: the tags in the field's box (text, remove button, "+N"), the text input after them and the arrow.

box.$description: The field's box as the tag box lays it out: the room above and below the tags (`inset`, which the tags' height follows).

tags.$description: The tags together: the space between them (also between rows once they wrap).

tag.$description: A tag: under the pointer, the one the keys are on (`focus`), while its item loads (`loading`), the "+N" tag for the items not shown (`more`), with no remove button (`fixed`: read only or disabled), `disabled`. Its height is the box's less the inset.

tag-text.$description: A tag's text (cut with an ellipsis).

remove.$description: A tag's remove button (none while read only or disabled).

arrow.$description: The arrow button (a field button: its hover, pressed and focus are the field's `button`); `open` while the list shows.

arrow-glyph.$description: The arrow button's glyph: `open` while the list shows.
